text: S6: sharing — invites (HMAC, 7d), members, leave, orphans

Design resolution (see commit ed2669e for full rationale): the ticket's literal
orphan_check interface ("zero memberships -> clear+tombstone") conflicts with
Spec §3's requirement that a departing user's *other* devices still converge on
the deletion via sync, since delta() filters by *current* membership. Fixed by
splitting into two behaviors: orphan_check(conn, list_id) tombstones iff count
is already zero (used by delete_account, which has no future session to
preserve propagation for); leave(conn, account_id, list_id) is the actual
/leave endpoint and, when it would orphan the list, tombstones content but
KEEPS the departing membership row so sibling devices still see it via
incremental sync.

IMPORTANT for T-8/S8 (GC): must delete that lingering membership row TOGETHER
WITH the list row when hard-deleting a tombstoned orphaned list — the
memberships FK (foreign_keys=ON) will block deleting a still-referenced list
otherwise.
